guide.summary: Makes the water less sour, raising its pH.
guide.biology: Alkaline substances balance out acids, but water that is too alkaline is uncomfortable for many microbes too.
guide.rules: Adds base equivalents that dissolve and diffuse. Shown pH = 7 + (base - acid) / (1 + buffer), kept between 2 and 12. Each tick equal amounts of acid and base cancel out, so base can undo acid. Most bacteria prefer pH 6 to 8 and algae 6.5 to 8.5; suitability fades to zero over 1.0 pH outside a species' range. No additional modeled reaction.
guide.example: When Bubbles have made the water sour, add alkalizer nearby and watch the pH overlay move back toward 7.
